## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is
one. Keep security vulnerability details in the private reporting channel.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Distinguish fixture, Qt and physical
hardware checks, and mention skipped checks. For documentation-only changes,
state that here.

## Compatibility and control impact

If relevant, explain effects on saved Linked/Separate profiles, migration,
privileged paths or authorization, and startup/sleep/recovery behavior. Include
any known limitations. Remove this section if it does not apply.
